In support of the RAN objective to enhance the quality of RAN4 RRM specifications, RAN4 approved a set of Change Requests (CRs) to TS 38.133 and communicated this decision to RAN5 via liaison statement [1]. Subsequently, at the RAN5#106 meeting, RAN5 resolved to initiate a corresponding follow-up activity and allocated the associated tasks among the participating companies [2]. RAN5 has conducted a similar quality improvement initiative for its own specifications - TS 38.533 (RRM) and TS 37.571-1 (Positioning) - to ensure alignment with the core specification TS 38.133. The Change Requests (CRs) submitted as part of this effort are listed below. Details of the editorial modifications and the items proposed for implementation by MCC are provided in Annexes A.1 and A.2, respectively. CRs to
